title: OfferCommentsResponse
description: GET /api/offers/{offerId}/comments success response. Mirrors DealsSeeker.Shared.Contracts.Comments.OfferCommentsResponseDto. Spec IDs: OFFERS.COMMENTS.001, OFFERS.COMMENTS.PAGINATION.001

comments.description: Comments belonging to the requested page, ordered from oldest to newest.

hasMore.description: Indicates whether further comments exist for the offer.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor identifying the position of the following page. Absent or null when there are no further comments.
